offering_description.value: Ribbon supplies IP routing and optical transport equipment, secure cloud and voice communications, and network automation software to telecommunications providers, enterprises, critical infrastructure operators, and defense agencies. It delivers communications through cloud-native platforms and provides network design, deployment, and maintenance.

quotes.quote: About Ribbon Ribbon Communications delivers, AIOps and automation, secure cloud communications and IP and optical networking solutions to service providers, enterprises, mission-critical defense, and critical infrastructure sectors globally. We engage deeply with our customers, helping them modernize their networks for improved competitive positioning and business outcomes in today's smart, always-on, and data-hungry world. Our end-to-end portfolio of communications software, IP routing, and optical networking solutions delivers superior value and innovation by leveraging cloud-native architectures, automation and analytics tools, and leading-edge security. We maintain a keen focus on our commitments to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) matters, offering an annual Sustainability Report to our stakeholders.

Ribbon's industry-leading product portfolio ranges from IP Systems, Optical Systems, and session border controllers ("SBCs") for service providers and enterprises, intelligent edge with SD-WAN, Network Edge Orchestration, policy and routing, call controllers or softswitches, media gateways, applications platforms, communications clients, and signaling controllers to cloud communications "as a Service" solutions. The company's comprehensive portfolio also includes unrivaled end-to-end service assurance, security, fraud management and analytics solutions. All of these solutions are supported by a global services team with extensive experience in design, deployment and maintenance of some of the world's largest IP and optical networks.

regulatory_exposure.value: high: U.S. defense deployments require interoperability approvals, including DISA JITC certification and DoDIN Approved Products List placement for relevant products.

quotes.quote: Government and defense deployments demand proven, certified solutions. Ribbon backs key claims with DoD interoperability approvals, strong assurance signals, and large-scale deployments.

Ribbon supports defense missions with certified, interoperable communications and transport solutions. Ribbon products have achieved DISA JITC certification and are listed on the DISA/DoDIN Approved Products List (APL), including SBC and gateway platforms as well as PSX, RAMP, and Analytics. Ribbon was selected as the technology provider for DISA’s Soft Switch Backbone (SSBB) modernization program, our SBCs are FIPS compliant, JITC certified, and certified for Microsoft Teams, with Ribbon’s SBCs included in the Microsoft Teams DoDIN APL System Under Test. Ribbon is CMMC Certified with maximum number of points.
